0022600187.text: The Magic (2-5, 0-4 at home, 2-1 on the road, losers of two) are 11th in the East and 5th in the Southeast, two games back, and visit a Phoenix Suns team (1-4, 1-1 at home, 0-3 on the road, losers of three) that is 12th in the West and 3rd in the Pacific, 3.5 games back. Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain) and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), while Phoenix is without Jordan Goodwin (calf), Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with Orlando winning the most recent meeting 115-111 in Orlando on March 31.
